newsitem.title: USA: CME live, feeder cattle futures end higher.
newsitem.headline: CME live, feeder cattle futures end higher.

text.p: CME live and feeder cattle futures closed higher with live cattle supported by news of cash trades at $70.00 and $71.00 per cwt in feedlot markets Wednesday, traders said.
Feeder cattle largely followed gains in live cattle, but volume was light.
Texas and Nebraska feedlots reported moderate to active cattle trading at $70.00 per cwt Wednesday, with a few at $71.00. CME traders said more $71.00 sales are likely this week.

The October live cattle contract continued to be supported by short covering ahead of Thursday's expiration. However, traders said a large number of positions were liquidated Wednesday and more longs should be willing sellers Thursday.
"We brought it (October) up to a level where the longs are going to make money on their futures position," said Jim Clarkson, analyst with A and A Inc.
Clarkson estimated October's open interest slipped under 3,000 contracts Wednesday, which would be a manageable level for the last trading day. October open interest Tuesday was 5,282.
